title: Feature Request: Version Information in Settings
symptom: The user requests a section labeled 'About' at the bottom of the settings page listing xDrip version information and anything else useful in describing issues. They find the version display confusing because it is not clear what component the version refers to.
fix: The maintainers point out that the version is displayed in the System Status page under the Classic Status Page tab, and provide a link to documentation on how to find the xDrip version. No code change was made; the issue was closed as the information is already available.
evidence_quote: if you go to the left side menu and select `System Status` the first tab (named `Classic Status Page`) will display the version number
